native_mechanisms: Nightingales always land first on the stone carrying the smallest owed letter (strict min-selection of the closest tentative node).
Threads cast from the tower price each road by its thief's toll, one direction at a time (directed, non-negative per-edge relaxation from the current node).
A locked letter is never rebuilt again, and threads reaching nowhere are dropped and thrown away (permanent settling of finalized nodes; stale/lazy entries discarded).
core_technique: Delta-stepping SSSP: bucket/bag ring of distance bands (delta = mean edge weight) with re-relaxation of tentative nodes, optional OpenMP CAS-min relaxation, plus work-limit bailout and guard conditions handing off to a lazy 4-ary-heap Dijkstra (which is also the small/degenerate-graph path).
